summary: Adds global validation/sanitizer, allows SVG/GIF uploads; but truncates functions.php (parse error, site breaks) and deletes still-used block helpers.

statements.text: ! Uploads now accept SVG files... one user could attack others, admins included. Leave SVG out or serve uploads from a separate domain.
statements.why: Real stored XSS risk via SVG uploads.

statements.text: The agent changed the admin edit user, admin site, studio page, studio background and import data parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: The whole site breaks: functions.php cut off mid-function (footer() unclosed), PHP syntax error loaded on every request.
Block helper functions (setBlockAssetContext, block_asset, block_text, bt, ...) deleted but still used; link blocks crash.
Admin 'Edit user' now rejects saves when password box is empty (or no handle/email).
Profile/page descriptions and text blocks go through a stricter HTML sanitizer; may strip formatting.
Needs `composer dump-autoload` on deploy so validation.php is loaded.
